description: The state table of every CoreX admin screen (spec 116, US-NFR-05; Definition of Done item 8): for each list or panel, what it shows when empty, loading, failed and refused. A screen WordPress's menu lists without an entry here fails states.spec.js. Written 2026-10-21 from the screens as they are; where a screen does not do what its row says, states.spec.js reports it and known-failures.json names the story that fixes it. A screen's own spec may point at its entry instead of repeating it.
refusedForAll: A person without the screen's ability gets CoreX's access-denied page: what the screen is, that they cannot open it, and who to ask or how to request access (spec 083, spec 112).

panels.name: Readiness and recent activity
panels.empty: No activity yet, and the next step to take.
panels.loading: Placeholders the size of each card.
panels.failed: The card says it could not load, with a retry; the other cards still show.

panels.name: Each settings section
panels.empty: Every field shows its default and says it is the default.
panels.failed: A save that fails says so and keeps what was typed (US-SET-01).

panels.name: Add-on cards, per filter tab
panels.empty: No add-on in this filter, and a link to all add-ons.
panels.loading: Server-rendered; a card being turned on or off shows its own progress.
panels.failed: Turning an add-on on or off that fails says what happened on the card (US-SAFE-08).

panels.name: Flow catalogue
panels.empty: No forms yet, and how to make the first one.
panels.loading: Placeholder rows, never 'no forms' before the answer (spec 108).
panels.failed: The list could not be loaded, with a retry.

panels.name: Inbox list
panels.empty: No messages have arrived yet, with a link to the forms.
panels.failed: The inbox could not be loaded, with a retry.

panels.name: Submission drawer
panels.failed: The submission could not be opened, with a retry.

panels.name: Models and records
panels.empty: No records in this model yet, and where they come from.
panels.loading: Placeholder rows the size of the table, no 'no records' text (spec 108).
panels.failed: The records could not be loaded, with a retry.
panels.refused: access-denied page; security models only for their owners (spec 112)

panels.name: Mode, readiness and each tab
panels.empty: Each list (activity, lockouts) says there is nothing yet.
panels.loading: Server-rendered; actions show their own progress.
panels.failed: An action that fails says so in words beside it.

panels.name: Overview, role matrix, audit and denied log
panels.empty: No requests, grants or refusals yet, each said in words.
panels.loading: Server-rendered; actions show their own progress.
panels.failed: An approval or revocation that fails says so beside it.
panels.refused: access-denied page; locked abilities say an administrator grants them (spec 112)

panels.name: Posts and comments

panels.failed: The widget says it could not load, and a failed PageSpeed run shows an error, never a grade (US-SAFE-12).

panels.failed: Server-rendered; a guide that cannot be read is left out.
